headline.businessplan: This is a German business plan ({{pages}} pages).

about.general: A general document. Virtus can explain structure and suggest actions based on what was found.
about.invoice: Looks like an invoice or bill. Amounts and parties are only reported if found in your file.
about.official: Looks like an official or authority notice. Deadlines and references are only shown if detected.
about.cv: Looks like a CV / résumé. Experience and skills are only listed if present in your file.
about.cover: Looks like a cover / application letter based on detected wording.
about.spreadsheet: Looks like a spreadsheet or table file. Rows and sheets depend on the source quality.
about.scan: Looks like a photo or scan. OCR quality depends on focus, lighting and angle.
about.contract: Looks like an employment-related contract draft. Not legal advice — facts must come from you.
about.bank: Looks like a bank statement. IBAN and balances are only shown if present in the file.
about.businessplan: A business plan describing the company, offer, market and financial planning — based on sections actually found in this file.
